overview_description.description: Gridware offers a grid-intelligence platform that equips utilities with real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental conditions of their overhead infrastructure. Its core product, GridScope, is a small, solar-powered sensor mounted on utility poles that continuously monitors mechanical vibrations, electrical activity, and ambient stressors even during outages. On-device analytics identify hazards, localize faults, and classify their severity, allowing line crews to respond efficiently and safely. Through its Active Grid Response system, Gridware helps utilities detect issues before they escalate, supporting timely maintenance and more stable grid operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Gridware is a grid‑technology company dedicated to improving safety and reliability on the electrical transmission and distribution systems.

product.name: Active Grid Response (AGR)
product.description: A platform providing real-time detection, localization, and identification of electrical grid hazards by monitoring physical, electrical, and environmental conditions at utility poles.

product.name: Gridscope
product.description: A multi-sensor device installed on utility poles that continuously monitors physical, electrical, structural, and environmental conditions to support real-time grid hazard detection and monitoring.

product.name: Applied Research Complex (ARC)
product.description: A testing facility that simulates real-world electrical grid conditions to evaluate and improve Gridware’s hazard detection technologies and platform performance.
